title: 深海の伽藍と、渡り鳥の軌跡
author: 神楽坂 探

en.title: The Deep Sea Cathedral and the Migratory Bird's Trace
en.premise: At an observation base perched atop a sheer cliff, an archaeologist is found dead within a locked laboratory. Beside the body lie migratory bird feathers, arranged with an inexplicable, haunting precision. As the investigation into unknown underwater ruins deep beneath the sea progresses, a series of mysterious phenomena begin to unfold. The detective I observe quietly, yet coldly, begins to unravel the threads of logic woven by the feathers and the ocean currents.

zh.title: 深海伽蓝与候鸟的轨迹
zh.premise: 在矗立于断崖绝壁上的观测基地内，一名考古学家被发现死于密室状态的研究室中。遗体旁留下了排列得异常整齐、令人费解的候鸟羽毛。随着对深海中未知海底遗迹调查的深入，各种不可思议的现象接连发生。我所注视着的侦探，正冷静而冷彻地，解开由羽毛与海流交织而成的逻辑之线。
